context: Mei and Aoi laugh about a strange morning.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (まるで/多分/やや/おかしい/さっき) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: さっき、変な夢の話、聞いてよ。
lines.en: Listen to my weird dream from earlier.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、どんな夢?おかしいの?
lines.en: Sure, what dream? Is it funny?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle curious delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まるで、空を飛んでるみたいだったの。
lines.en: It was just like flying in the sky.
lines.style: animated barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それは、多分疲れてるんだよ。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: やや、寝不足かもしれないね。
lines.en: I might be slightly short on sleep.
lines.style: thoughtful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: さっきも、あくびしてたもんね。
lines.style: amused woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まるで子供みたいで、おかしいでしょ?
lines.en: Just like a kid — funny, right?
lines.style: giggly barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 多分、今夜は早く寝た方がいいよ。
lines.en: You should probably sleep early tonight.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm caring closing delivery throughout
